content.rendered:
Think about it! Heels and formal shoes are painful after a while…

Why not get a crate of classy wedding flip flops as a surprise for your guests??? Even Grandma and maybe Grandpa could use a pair to dance the night away in!

They are fun too!

You can buy them online here www.etsy.com/uk/listing/238414462/30-white-and-silver-wedding-flip-flops

We don’t get a commission we’d just love it if you thought about this…. Even your DJ could wear a pair….
